description: This header file defines the interface for the VideoDecoder component in a TR-069 based device management system. It includes class declarations, external file references, and API documentation related to video decoding capabilities.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceVideoDecoder
classes.description: Class providing TR069 component video decoder information and interface management, including instance handling, update checking, and message handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the video decoder interface for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the specified video decoder instance.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for updates in the video decoder interface, such as status and standby mode.

methods.name: getAllInstances
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all existing video decoder instances.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Closes all existing video decoder instances.

methods.name: getLock
methods.description: Acquires a lock for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: doUpdates
methods.description: Performs update operations on the video decoder interface.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set messages for specific parameters.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get messages for specific parameters.
